releaseData.title: College Hill vs The Galaxy
releaseData.description: An updated compilation of College Hill vs. The World Volumes 1 & 2, released in 2013 and 2014 respectively. These tracks use elements from original College Hill tunes to recreate classic grime tracks, blurring the line between remix, cover, and mashup. This remastered release features two additional tracks produced in 2015 and 2018.
